about: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 4.0 bpw (SC H5) with its built-in MTP head and vision on unpatched TabbyAPI and the official ExLlamaV3 1.6.3 ROCm 10 wheels, gfx1100; from kamm3r/exl3-rdna3-recipe

config.text:
# Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 4.0 bpw on one RX 7900 XTX (24 GB): 128K context, Q8 KV cache, MTP draft, vision.
# Paths are relative to tabbyAPI/ (serve/run.sh starts the server from there).
network:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 5000
  disable_auth: true
  allowed_origins: []

logging:
  log_prompt: false
  log_requests: false

model:
  model_dir: ../models
  model_name: Qwen3.8-27B-exl3-SC4.0
  backend: exllamav3
  max_seq_len: 131072
  cache_size: 131072
  cache_mode: 8,8
  max_batch_size: 1
  chunk_size: 2048
  vision: true
  vision_offload: true
  reasoning: true
  tool_format: qwen3_coder

draft_model:
  draft_mode: mtp
  # The model has one MTP layer; drafting 3 tokens instead of the default 4 measured ~9% faster decode here.
  draft_num_tokens: 3

setup: Not Docker; Linux on an RX 7900 XTX (gfx1100). setup/install.sh clones TabbyAPI at e086a65 (unpatched) into a Python 3.12 uv venv and installs the measured package set (setup/requirements.lock.txt: torch 2.13.0+rocm10.0.0, rocm 10.0.0 and amd-torch-device-gfx1100 from AMD's whl-next indexes, the official exllamav3 1.6.3+rocm10.0 wheel); nothing compiles and no system ROCm is needed, only the amdgpu kernel driver. setup/download_model.sh fetches the pinned weights; serve/run.sh starts TabbyAPI with serve/config.yml: 131072 context, cache_mode 8,8, max_batch_size 1, MTP draft with draft_num_tokens 3, reasoning, tool_format qwen3_coder, vision with vision_offload (encoder weights in system RAM). HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES selects the discrete card over a Ryzen iGPU. Peaks around 21 GiB of the card's 24 GiB with the desktop on the same card.
